verdict.rationale: MoonPay's dev docs include structured API reference pages (e.g., quotes/get, sessions/create) and a separate GitHub repo of clone-able demo integrations, but there's no evidence of an interactive, in-browser 'try it now' console — a probe for standard OpenAPI/swagger endpoints returned 404s, suggesting no exposed spec powering live runnable examples. Missing for 10: in-docs interactive request builder/console, publicly exposed OpenAPI spec, and confirmation that example code snippets are directly executable from the reference pages.
